description: CPU and memory-first view for Power BI Report Server / SSRS hosts: fleet KPIs, color-coded pressure table, live trends, and process-level RS/RSPortal/Mashup consumption. Pair with profiles/powerbi-report-server.yml.

panels.title: CPU and Memory at a Glance

panels.description: Highest host CPU utilization across PBIRS fleet.

targets.expr: max((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",mode="idle"}[5m])))) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: MaxCPU

panels.description: Lowest available memory % Ã¢ï¿½,ï¿½ï¿½?ï¿½ primary RAM pressure signal.

targets.expr: min((100 * windows_memory_available_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) or vector(100)

panels.title: MinMem

panels.description: Highest memory consumption % across PBIRS hosts.

targets.expr: max((100 - (100 * windows_memory_available_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"})) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: MemUsed

panels.description: Committed memory vs commit limit Ã¢ï¿½,ï¿½ï¿½?ï¿½ paging pressure ahead of OOM.

targets.expr: max((100 * windows_memory_committed_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} / windows_memory_commit_limit{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Commit

targets.expr: count(((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",mode="idle"}[5m])))) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) > 85) or vector(0)

count(((100 * windows_memory_available_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)(PowerBIReportServer|PBIRS.+|SQLServerReportingServices|ReportServer.+)"}))) < 10) or vector(0)
